newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo knocked lower vs mark by French franc.
newsitem.headline: Escudo knocked lower vs mark by French franc.

text.p: The Portuguese escudo was trading lower against the mark, weakened by the retreat of the French franc in response to the left-wing victory in France's general election.

The currency was trading at 101.26/29 to the mark against its 101.16/19 close on Friday with traders seeing the currency moving on Monday between 101.20 and 101.40 -- level at which the Bank of Portugal could intervene.
